🗳️ "Ask for a little more." Remember that phrase — it's how governments announce they're about to raise your taxes.

Andy Burnham has been PM for three weeks. He was chosen by Labour members, not the country. And he's already floating a care levy, hinting at scrapping inheritance tax, and saying the Government "might be having to ask for a little more" — on top of the highest tax burden in living memory and frozen thresholds dragging workers into higher bands.

Reform UK would let people keep more of what they earn — and would restore the principle that a PM who wants to raise your taxes should first win your vote.
